## Context
Current billing is user-scoped.

## Decisions
Team billing belongs to workspaces. Workspace owners manage seats.

## Contracts
Subscription owner is workspace_id. Seat count comes from active memberships. Invoices include workspace name.

## Tasks
1. Add workspace subscription ownership.
2. Add seat-count tests.
3. Update invoice rendering.
